group_note: 三界神话『宝鸡站』(San Jie Shen Hua, Baoji station edition), first of a 5-lib family cluster (sjsh/sjshv150/sjshv2578bb/sjshwzb/sjshwzjqb). WASM pass fixed: (1) corrupted raw bytes in adm/daemons/convertd.lpc's Greek/GBK-conversion mapping tables -- 44 lines had a stray non-UTF8 byte sequence immediately before the closing quote whose last byte happened to be 0x5C (backslash), escaping the closing quote and leaving the string literal unterminated, breaking compilation; fixed by stripping just the offending trailing backslash+garbage on each flagged line via a byte-level script (left the other, non-compile-blocking mojibake content in the same tables untouched -- pure content-quality noise, not a boot blocker, out of scope per the standing convention). (2) §7.41-class corrupted shipped save data: adm/daemons/emoted.lpc's create() called an unguarded restore() on its own corrupted save file; guarded with catch(restore()) plus an explicit emote=([]) fallback (the caught error still logs verbosely via this mudlib's own error_handler(), confirmed harmless/expected, matching the pattern already documented for sjplgfjxb). Registration flow note (not a bug, needed for testing/future reference): a genuinely new id must be entered as the literal word 'new' first, THEN the desired id, THEN the Chinese name -- confirm_id() is called automatically with a hardcoded 'Yes', there is no y/n confirmation step. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist. Verified: full registration (new->id->name->password->confirm->email->webpage->icq->gender) -> look/score/quit all clean, permission displays (admin) for the admin account; trusted_write['/']/exclude_write also directly source-verified to grant (admin) unrestricted write access. LPC formatter run across all 9350 files; reverted 2 files with confirmed CJK re-spacing corruption found via the same-text-despaced-matches-old-file scan across 79 formatter-touched files; also directly diff-reviewed the one map.lpc ASCII-art-adjacent file present -- clean, cosmetic only. Post-formatter re-verified clean.
